questions_and_answers.question_text: What are the two meanings of ...yě hǎo, ...yě hǎo?
What NEW use of cái is introduced here?
Write the Chinese for "I won't go unless you do."
Write the Chinese for "Whether or not you are going, I'm going for sure."

answers.answer_text: Nǐ qù yě hǎo, bú qù yě hǎo, wǒ yídìng qù.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "Only in this way is it good."
In what sense did you see cái earlier?
Write the Chinese for "I won't buy it unless it's cheap."

answers.answer_text: The resultative sense of continuing — "to go on preserving."

articles.text:
3. A: Xué pīnyīn yě hǎo, bù xué      Whether you study romanization or not,
      pīnyīn yě hǎo, Zhōngguo zì     you'll always have to study Chinese
      zǒng děi xué.                  characters.
   B: Shì a, zhèiyàng Zhōngguo      Yes, this is the only way Chinese
      wénhuà cái néng bǎochíxiaqu.   culture can continue to be preserved.

Notes on No. 3

...yě hǎo, ...yě hǎo: This pattern can mean either (1) "WHETHER...OR..." or (2) "BOTH...AND...."

Nǐ qù yě hǎo, bú qù yě hǎo, wǒ   Whether or not you are going, I'm going
yídìng qù.                       for sure.
Tā lái yě hǎo, bù lái yě hǎo,    Whether or not he comes, let's start
zánmen xiān chī fàn ba.          eating.

The SECOND meaning, "both...and...":

Zhōngguo rén yě hǎo, Měiguo rén  Chinese people and American people
yě hǎo, dōu yīnggāi bǎochí       should both preserve their cultural
tāmende wénhuà chuántǒng.        heritage.

cái: You've already seen cái in talking about TIME ("not until"). Here you see another use of cái, "NOT UNLESS." It points out a NECESSARY CONDITION.

Zhèijiàn shì, tā guǎn cái xíng.
"It won't be okay unless he takes care of this matter."

Shíge cái gòu.                   "No fewer than ten is enough."
Zhèiyàng cái hǎo.                "Only in this way is it good."
Piányi wǒ cái mǎi.               "I won't buy it unless it's cheap."
Nǐ qù wǒ cái qù.                 "I won't go unless you do."

bǎochí: "to keep, to preserve, to maintain"

Zhōngguo shèhuì hěn duō dìfang   There are a lot of places in Chinese
dōu bǎochízhe lǎode fēngsú       society which are still holding on to
xíguàn.                          old customs and habits.
